note: Seeded 2026-09-11 from the Google UK results for 'best walking tours london' and 'london walking tours'. best-walking-tours-london only lists tours sold on GetYourGuide, so these are what each source recommended whether or not GetYourGuide sells it. Time Out's 2023 and 2025 news stories on the Tripadvisor awards are syndication of the award, not separate sources. Tripadvisor's walking-tour ranking is the platform's own order and changes daily.

excluded.why: Content farm, not the UN body its name suggests: the WordPress archive is templated 'How to Book...' posts across Spanish cities, several a day in April 2026, and its London list is GetYourGuide product titles verbatim.
